citation.authors: Mantovani N, Pizzolati M, Edge D

cited_by.title: Stigma, talking to family and starting therapy

record.population: 26 men and women in Christian faith communities, south London
record.design: Qualitative interviews on stigma and help-seeking for mental illness
record.finding: Help-seeking was shaped by beliefs about the causes of mental illness, silencing driven by stigma, and stigma kept up at community level. People with a diagnosis could face triple jeopardy in stigma. The authors say one-size-fits-all approaches will not meet diverse needs.
record.note: Small qualitative study in one setting; shows themes, not how common they are.
